jobs.description:
Fachspezialist:in Konfliktmanagement und Mediation (m/w/d)

100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Die Abteilung Diversity und Kooperation ist im Schulleitungsbereich des Vizepräsidiums für Personalentwicklung und Leadership (VPPL) angesiedelt. Im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung des organisationsweiten Respekt- und Konfliktmanagementsystems der ETH Zürich wird in der Abteilung Diversity und Kooperation die neu verankerte Klärungsstelle aufgebaut und operativ gestärkt.

Als Teil des VPPL stehen wir für eine inklusive Kultur und Leadership ein, begegnen unseren Mitmenschen auf Augenhöhe, übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, denken und arbeiten vernetzt und haben eine Leidenschaft für innovative Ansätze – dies mit Mut und Leichtigkeit. Unsere Vision: Gemeinsam befähigen wir Menschen, das Potenzial ihrer selbst und anderer zu entfalten. Hier gelangen Sie zu einem kurzen Video-Interview mit unserer Vizepräsidentin Julia Dannath.

Als Fachspezialist:in Konfliktmanagement und Mediation übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung, Steuerung und strukturellen Einbettung komplexer Konflikt- und Beschwerdekonstellationen in der gesamten Institution. Sie gewährleisten die qualifizierte Konzeption, Führung und Dokumentation strukturierter Klärungsprozesse in anspruchsvollen Einzelfällen und stellen sicher, dass diese in kohärenter Weise in das übergeordnete institutionelle System eingebettet sind.

Stellenbeschreibung

Beratung & Befähigung

• Sie beraten Führungspersonen, Mitarbeitende sowie Organisationseinheiten in komplexen Konfliktlagen und nehmen dabei eine klar strukturierende, allparteiliche und prozessverantwortliche Rolle ein. Im Zentrum steht die professionelle Steuerung von Klärungsprozessen unter Berücksichtigung organisationaler, kultureller und struktureller Rahmenbedingungen.

• Ein zentraler Bestandteil Ihres Mandats ist die Beratung und Befähigung von Führungskräften im Umgang mit Konflikten, Eskalationsdynamiken und organisationsbezogenen Entscheidungs- und Verantwortungssituationen. Diese Funktion ist integraler Bestandteil der institutionellen Governance im Bereich Respekt- und Konfliktmanagement.

• Gleichzeitig übernehmen Sie die fachliche Prozessberatung und Systemunterstützung anderer interner Anlauf- und Beratungsstellen. Sie tragen damit zur Systematisierung und Weiterentwicklung organisationsweiter Vorgehensweisen im Umgang mit Respekt- und Konfliktthemen bei.

Prävention & Transfer

• Ihre Tätigkeit geht explizit über die Einzelfallbearbeitung hinaus. Sie verstehen Konflikte auch als systemische Indikatoren organisationaler Dynamiken.

• Sie stellen sicher, dass Erkenntnisse aus der Klärungsarbeit systematisch erhoben, verdichtet und in geeigneter Form in die Organisation rückgeführt werden. Damit leisten Sie einen Beitrag zur strukturellen Lernfähigkeit der Institution sowie zur Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Präventions- und Qualitätsstandards.

• Darüber hinaus entwickeln und implementieren Sie Schulungs-, Sensibilisierungs- und Weiterbildungsformate für unterschiedliche Ziel- und Führungsebenen und tragen zur nachhaltigen Verankerung von Konfliktkompetenz als Bestandteil institutioneller Professionalität bei.

Positionierung & Weiterentwicklung

• Sie wirken aktiv an der Positionierung und Weiterentwicklung der Klärungsstelle als strategisch relevanten Pfeiler institutioneller Steuerung im Bereich Respekt- und Konfliktmanagement mit.

• Dabei verbinden Sie operative Fallverantwortung mit systemischer Reflexion, konzeptioneller Weiterentwicklung und organisationsweiter Perspektivbildung.

Profil

• Hochschulabschluss (Master oder vergleichbar), vorzugsweise in Psychologie, Rechtswissenschaften, Sozial- oder Organisationswissenschaften

• Fundierte Weiterbildung und Expertise in Mediat

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Specialista nella gestione dei conflitti e nella mediazione (m/f/d) - 100%, Zurigo, a tempo indeterminato Descrizione del Dipartimento di Diversità e Cooperazione è parte del Vicepresidio per lo Sviluppo del Personale e la Leadership (VPPL). Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del sistema di gestione del rispetto e del conflitto con il livello organizzativo dell'ETH Zurigo, il Dipartimento di Diversità e Cooperazione sta costruendo e rafforzando una nuova unità di mediazione. Come parte del VPPL, promuoviamo una cultura e una leadership inclusiva, interagiamo con i nostri colleghi su un piano di uguaglianza, assumiamo volentieri responsabilità, pensiamo e lavoriamo in modo interconnesso e abbiamo una passione per approcci innovativi, con coraggio e leggerezza. La nostra visione è la fonte della capacità della persona di saper utilizzare le potenzialità e quelle più anziane. Questa è una breve intervista video con la nostra Vice Presidente Julia Dannath. Come specialista nella gestione dei conflitti e mediazione, svolgerai un ruolo centrale nel gestire, controllare e integrare strutturalmente conflitti e lamentele complessi in tutta l'istituzione. Garantire la pianificazione, l'orientamento e la documentazione del processo di chiarimento strutturati in casi complessi e assicurare che questi siano integrazione in modo coerente nell'istituzionale generale. Mansioni Consultation e Empowerment - Consultazione con conduttori, assistenti e unità organizzative in situazioni di conflitto complesso con un ruolo strutturato, imparziale e responsabile del processo. Il centro è anche la gestione professionale del processo di chiarimento, che tiene conto delle condizioni organizzative, culturali e strutturali. - Consultazione e responsabilizzazione del direttore nei gesti contrastanti, nelle dinamiche di escalation e nella situazione di decisione e responsabilità organizzativa. Questa funzione fa parte integrante della governance istituzionale nel campo del rispetto e della gestione dei conflitti. - Processo di consultazione e sistema di supporto su altri punti di contatto e consultazione internamente. Contribuisci alla sistematizzazione e allo sviluppo di approcci organizzativi per affrontare questioni di rispetto e conflitti. Prevenzione e Trasferimento - Attività che vanno oltre il trattamento dei casi individuali. Ci sono conflitti con gli indicatori dei sistemi organizzativi dinamici. - Garantire che le conoscenze acquisite dal lavoro di chiarimento siano raccolte, concentrate e ripristinate all'organizzazione in modo appropriato. Questo contribuisce a tutta la capacità di apprendimento strutturale dell'istituzione e allo sviluppo di standard di governance, prevenzione e qualità. - Sviluppo e implementazione di formati di forma, sensibilità e aggiornamento per diversi livelli di destinazione e leadership, contribuendo a tutta la radice sostenuta di competenza nel campo dei conflitti come parte della professionalità istituzionale. Posizione e Sviluppo - Partecipazione attiva alla posizione e allo sviluppo dell'unità di chiarimento come pilastro strategicamente rilevante della gestione isituzionale nel campo del rispetto e della gestione dei conflitti. - Combinando la responsabilità operativa dell'involucro con il sistema di carabina, lo sviluppo concettuale e la formazione di prospettive e livello organizzativo.
• Requisiti - Laurea (Master o equivalente), preferibilmente in Psicologia, Giurisprudenza, Scienze Sociali o Scienze Organizzative - Formazione approfondita ed esperienza come mediatore

• Ihre Tätigkeit geht explizit über die Einzelfallbearbeitung hinaus. Sie verstehen Konflikte auch als systemische Indikatoren organisationaler Dynamiken.
• Sie stellen sicher, dass Erkenntnisse aus der Klärungsarbeit systematisch erhoben, verdichtet und in geeigneter Form in die Organisation rückgeführt werden. Damit leisten Sie einen Beitrag zur strukturellen Lernfähigkeit der Institution sowie zur Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Präventions- und Qualitätsstandards.
• Darüber hinaus entwickeln und implementieren Sie Schulungs-, Sensibilisierungs- und Weiterbildungsformate für unterschiedliche Ziel- und Führungsebenen und tragen zur nachhaltigen Verankerung von Konfliktkompetenz als Bestandteil institutioneller Professionalität bei. jobs.description:
Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Training Network – Coupled Problems for Decarbonization in Industry and Power Generation (COMBINE)

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Training Network COMBINE brings together 17 academic institutions and 14 industrial partners across Europe.The network addresses key challenges in fluid structure interaction (FSI) relevant to energy, process, and materials engineering, with a strong focus on:

• Advanced numerical modelling and simulation

• Experimental methods and sensor technologies

• Data analysis of real-world monitoring data

• Artificial intelligence and machine learning for engineering applications

Researchers in COMBINE benefit from interdisciplinary, international,and inter-sectoral training, including secondments at leading academic and industrial partner institutions across Europe.

Project background

Project title: High resolution experimental measurements of vibrations in rods and rod bundles using ensemble average high-resolution gamma tomography measurements.

This project focuses on the development of advanced tomographic techniques to evalute vibrations in rod bundles. The research will leverage our in-house, state-of-the-art, high-resolution gamma tomography system.

Job description

• Construction of a setup with a single rod and a rod bundle

• Measurements of vibrating rod/rod-bundle using our in-house gamma-tomography system

• AI-assisted reconstruction and imaging of vibrating rods/bundles using sensors and tomography data

• Use of machine-learning for noise reduction and data enhancement

Profile

• Master's degree in engineering, physics, applied mathematics, computer science, or closely related field

• Strong background in mathematics and machine learning

• Programming proficiency in Python, C++ or similar

• Experience with data processing and model interpretation

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international research environment

• Good written and spoken English

• Hands-on experience with experimental setup and basic electronics understanding is of advantage

Workplace

We offer

• Excellent research environment

• Supervision by internationally recognized academic and industrial experts

• Network-wide training events and local courses in technical and transferable skills

• International secondments at academic and industrial partner institutions across Europe

• Competitive salary

• The research group offices and experimental laboratory are located at Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Forschungsstrasse 111, 5232 Villigen

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

• CV

Further information about the Laboratory of Nuclear Systems and Multiphase Flows can be found on our Website . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Prof. Annalisa Manera, maneraa@ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

• la modélisation numérique avancée et la simulation
• les méthodes expérimentales et les technologies de capteurs

Contexte du projet Titre du projet : Mesures expérimentales à haute résolution des vibrations dans les tiges et les faisceaux de tiges à l'aide de mesures tomographiques gamma moyennes à haute résolution de l'ensemble. Ce projet est axé sur le développement de techniques tomographiques avancées pour évaluer les vibrations dans les faisceaux de tiges. La recherche tirera parti de notre système de tomographie gamma à haute résolution, à la fine pointe de la technologie. Description de l'emploi
• Construction d'une installation avec une seule tige et un faisceau de tiges
• Mesures de la tige vibrante/groupe de tiges utilisant notre système de gammatomographie interne
• Reconstruction assistée par l'IA et imagerie de tiges vibrantes/groupes utilisant des capteurs et des données de tomographie

jobs.description:
Sus.lab Internship

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

Join the Sustainability in Business Lab (sus.lab) at ETH Zurich for a 6-month paid internship and contribute to projects that advance a net-zero and circular economy. Sus.lab is part of the Group for Sustainability and Technology (SusTec) at ETH Zurich. As a “think-and-do-tank,” we work with industry, policymakers, and academia on topics such as carbon dioxide removal, circular economy, food waste, and maritime shipping.

Job description

• Support project leads in delivering first-of-a-kind results for ongoing industry projects such as the Carbon Removal Booster , Food Waste Reduction for Households , or Hydrogen-powered shipping

• Work independently on assigned tasks in close collaboration with the project team

• Dive into new technologies and handle analytical, organizational, and communication-related tasks such as market and policy research, assessment of emerging technologies, stakeholder interviews, workshop preparation, preparation of reports, and presenting findings to partners

Profile

• You are available for 6 months, starting in August or September 2026

• You are based in Zurich, Switzerland during the time of the internship

Note: Remote work is not possible due to employment regulations

• You have completed your Bachelor’s degree, are currently enrolled in a Master’s degree, or have recently completed your Master’s degree

Note: Applicants with a completed PhD are not suitable for this role

Note for citizens of countries outside Switzerland and the EU/EFTA: you may only apply if you are currently enrolled as a student and required to complete a compulsory internship as part of your Master’s studies

• You are at the beginning of your career and have no more than 12 months of full-time work experience

• You have excellent written and spoken English skills (C1); German is an advantage but not required

• You have strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills

• You are comfortable working at the intersection of business, technology, and policy and are ready to dig into technical details, business aspects, or policy implications

• You are proactive, curious, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and enjoy taking ownership of your work

Workplace

We offer

• Hands-on experience in impactful, industry-facing sustainability and technology projects

• Collaboration with startups, corporates, policy makers, and interdisciplinary teams

• Insight into the real-world commercialization and implementation of sustainability technologies

• A collaborative and inclusive environment with colleagues from diverse backgrounds

• Ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to work independently on meaningful topics

• Support with accessibility needs or accommodations throughout the application process and internship

Teamleitung ETH Diversity (m/w/d)

80%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

ETH Diversity ist Teil der Abteilung Diversity und Kooperation und ist im Schulleitungsbereich des Vizepräsidiums für Personalentwicklung und Leadership (VPPL) angesiedelt. Als Teil von VPPL stehen wir für eine inklusive Kultur und Leadership ein, begegnen unseren Mitmenschen auf Augenhöhe, übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, denken und arbeiten vernetzt und haben eine Leidenschaft für innovative Ansätze – dies mit Mut und Leichtigkeit. Unsere Vision: Gemeinsam befähigen wir Menschen, das Potenzial ihrer selbst und anderer zu entfalten. Hier gelangen Sie zu einem kurzen Video-Interview mit unserer Vizepräsidentin Julia Dannath.

Als Teamleitung ETH Diversity verantworten Sie die strategische und operative Weiterentwicklung von Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion an der ETH Zürich. In Ihrer Rolle bewegen Sie sich an der Schnittstelle von Hochschulleitung, Organisationseinheiten und externen Anspruchsgruppen. Sie stellen sicher, dass DEI-Aspekte systematisch in Strukturen, Prozesse und die Organisationskultur der ETH integriert werden und entwickeln dafür kohärente, hochschulweite Strategien und Programme. Sie verstehen Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion als strategische Querschnittsaufgabe verantwortungsvoller Hochschulentwicklung und als zentralen Bestandteil von Exzellenz, Innovation und Chancengerechtigkeit.

Stellenbeschreibung

• Sie führen das Diversity-Team fachlich und personell und positionieren das Themenfeld als integralen Bestandteil der institutionellen Weiterentwicklung der Hochschule.

• Sie beraten unsere Departemente und die Zentralen Organe in strategischen und konzeptionellen Fragen und verantworten die Weiterentwicklung sowie Umsetzung von Sensibilisierungs-, Schulungs- und Informationsformaten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.

• Sie entwickeln mit Ihrem Team tragfähige Massnahmen als Teil einer verantwortungsvollen Hochschulentwicklung und zentralen Bestandteil von Exzellenz, Innovation und Chancengleichheit.

• Sie vertreten ETH Diversity in relevanten internen und externen Gremien sowie Netzwerken und tragen zur nationalen wie internationalen Positionierung der ETH Zürich im DEI-Kontext bei.

• Sie beobachten und analysieren gesellschaftliche, rechtliche und hochschulpolitische Entwicklungen und übersetzen diese in strategisch relevante Handlungskonzepte für die ETH Zürich.

Profil

• Hochschulabschluss in Sozialwissenschaften, Organisationsentwicklung, Gender Studies oder einer verwandten Disziplin - oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung im DEI-Bereich

• Ausgeprägte Expertise in den Bereichen Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, strategischen Steuerung und Evaluation von DEI-Programmen

• Knowhow in der Konzeption und Implementierung von organisationsweiten Sensibilisierungs-, Schulungs- und Beratungsformaten

• Beratungs- und Moderationskompetenz im Zusammenhang mit Organisations- und Kulturentwicklungsprozessen

• Leadershipkompetenz mit integrativem, kooperativem Führungsstil

• Vertiefte Kenntnisse der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen in den Bereichen Gleichstellung, Diskriminierungsschutz und Verhaltenskodizes in komplexen Systemen

• Ausgeprägte strategische, analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit institutioneller Gesamtsicht

• Vernetzung im DEI-Kontext sowie Interesse an der Weiterentwicklung der nationalen und internationalen Vernetzung

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Arbeitsort

Wir bieten

• Ihr Beruf mit Wirkung: Werden Sie Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur Ihre berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt

• Es erwartet Sie ein äusserst spannendes Aufgabengebiet, in dem Sie Ihre Expertise ein

Gestione del team ETH Diversity (m/f/d) 80%, Zurigo, stampa permanente ETH Diversity fa parte della Divisione Diversità e Cooperazione e si trova nella Divisione Gestione della Scuola del Vice Presidente dello Sviluppo del Personale e Leadership (VPPL). Nell'ambito di VPPL, ci aspettiamo per una cultura e una leadership inclusiva, incontriamo i nostri simili esseri umani con un'uguaglianza di marcia, ci prendiamo la responsabilità, il pensiero e il lavoro in una rete e abbiamo una passione per gli approcci innovativi – con coraggio e facilità. La nostra visione: Insieme diamo potere alle persone di sviluppare il potenziale di se stessi e di altri. Ecco una breve intervista video con la nostra Vice Presidente Julia Dannath. Come Team Leader ETH Diversity, sei responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e operativo della diversità, dell'uguaglianza e dell'inclusione nell'ETH di Zurigo. Nel tuo ruolo, lavori all'interfaccia di gestione universitaria, unità organizzative e stakeholder esterni. Essi assicurano che gli aspetti del DEI siano sistematicamente integrati nelle strutture, nei processi e nella cultura organizzativa dell'ETE e sviluppino strategie e programmi coerenti e universitari. Essi comprendono la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione come compito strategico di taglio trasversale dello sviluppo universitario responsabile e come componente centrale di eccellenza, innovazione e pari opportunità. Descrizione del lavoro
• Si guida il team della diversità in termini di competenze e personale e posizionare l'argomento come parte integrante dello sviluppo istituzionale dell'università. Essi consigliano i nostri dipartimenti e enti centrali su questioni strategiche e concettuali e sono responsabili per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di formati di sensibilizzazione, formazione e informazione per diversi gruppi target.
• Insieme al vostro team, svilupperete misure sostenibili come parte dello sviluppo universitario responsabile e di una componente centrale di eccellenza, innovazione e pari opportunità.
• Esse rappresentano la diversità ETH in comitati e reti interni ed esterni rilevanti e contribuiscono al posizionamento nazionale ed internazionale dell'ETH di Zurigo nel contesto del DEI.
• Osservano e analizzano gli sviluppi della politica sociale, legale e universitaria e li traducono in concetti di azione strategicamente rilevanti per l'ETH Zurigo.
• Laurea in scienze sociali, sviluppo organizzativo, studi di genere o una disciplina correlata - o esperienza professionale equivalente nell'area del DEI
• Forte competenza nello sviluppo, nel controllo strategico e nella valutazione dei programmi del DEI
• Know-how nella concezione e nell'attuazione di sistemi di sensibilizzazione, formazione e consulenza organizzativi
• Competenze di consulenza e di moderazione in relazione ai processi di sviluppo organizzativo e culturale Si può aspettare un'area di lavoro estremamente emozionante in cui è possibile sviluppare la vostra esperienza

Team management ETH Diversity (m/f/d) 80%, Zurich, permanent print printing ETH Diversity is part of the Division of Diversity and Cooperation and is located in the School Management Division of the Vice President of Personnel Development and Leadership (VPPL). As part of VPPL, we stand for an inclusive culture and leadership, meet our fellow human beings on an equal footing, enjoy taking responsibility, thinking and working in a network and have a passion for innovative approaches – with courage and ease. Our vision: Together we empower people to develop the potential of themselves and others. Here is a short video interview with our Vice President Julia Dannath. As Team Leader ETH Diversity, you are responsible for the strategic and operational development of diversity, equality and inclusion at ETH Zurich. In your role, you work at the interface of university management, organizational units and external stakeholders. They ensure that DEI aspects are systematically integrated into the structures, processes and organizational culture of the ETH and develop coherent, university-wide strategies and programs. They understand diversity, equality and inclusion as a strategic cross-cutting task of responsible university development and as a central component of excellence, innovation and equal opportunities. Job description
• You lead the diversity team in terms of expertise and personnel and position the topic as an integral part of the university’s institutional development. They advise our departments and central bodies on strategic and conceptual issues and are responsible for the further development and implementation of awareness-raising, training and information formats for different target groups.
• Together with your team, you will develop sustainable measures as part of responsible university development and a central component of excellence, innovation and equal opportunities.
• They represent ETH Diversity in relevant internal and external committees and networks and contribute to the national and international positioning of ETH Zurich in the DEI context.
• They observe and analyze societal, legal and university policy developments and translate them into strategically relevant action concepts for ETH Zurich. Profile
• University degree in social sciences, organizational development, gender studies or a related discipline - or equivalent professional experience in the DEI area
• Strong expertise in the development, strategic control and evaluation of DEI programmes
• Know-how in the conception and implementation of organization-wide awareness-raising, training and consulting formats
• Consulting and moderation competence in connection with organizational and cultural development processes
• Leadership competence with integrative, cooperative leadership style
• In-depth knowledge of the legal and regulatory framework in the areas of equality, protection against discrimination and codes of conduct in complex systems
• Strong strategic, analytical and communicative skills with an overall institutional perspective
• Networking in the DEI context as well as interest in the further development of national and international networking
• Negotiation-proof German and English skills We offer
• Your profession with effect: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society
• You can expect an extremely exciting area of work in which you can develop your expertise

jobs.description:
Head of HSG ETH Student Project House

80%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

At the Student Project House (SPH) we inspire and empower students to cultivate a maker and innovator mindset. We believe that by developing their own projects, students learn important competencies for their future. This is why we’ve created an ecosystem to inspire students (Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral students) to get started and explore the real need behind their idea. And to seek diverse views, to work as a team, to think big, to fail, to pivot, and to keep overcoming obstacles they encounter along the way.

Our interdisciplinary team of thirty people designs and manages facilities like co-working, ideation spaces as well as a makerspace and lab that gives students access to the tools and equipment they need to prototype. We support project teams with personal coaching, workshops, and a pro-bono expert network from industry.

Our first location was established at ETH Zurich. As we scale and expand beyond our original base, we are launching a second location in St.Gallen in collaboration with the University of St.Gallen (HSG) and START Foundation. We are creating a sister organisation in the spirit of SPH in Zurich, with a large focus on building a community of ETH and HSG students who learn from each other through peer-to-peer learning. We are now seeking a Head of HSG ETH SPH to lead this new chapter.

Project background

You’ll work in one of the most inspiring spaces in St.Gallen, surrounded by whiteboards, ideation equipment, colourful furniture, and creative students. We’re located at the START Campus, 5 minutes away from both St.Gallen station and HSG.

We work in the same open space as our project teams and meet with everyone at eye level. The individuals we work with are from a diverse range of backgrounds and study disciplines, which is why we communicate in English. As the projects we support are extracurricular, most of our offers take place in the late afternoon, in the evening, and occasionally at weekends. The projects are very diverse regarding topic, stage, intensity, and goal - some being entrepreneurial and others non-profit.

We take an agile approach to conceptualizing and delivering our offer and allocate our capacity flexibly to the most important tasks. Hereby, teamwork is one of our key values.

Job description

Together, we empower student-led projects in innovation and for personal growth. As Head of HSG ETH SPH, you are responsible for the following:

• Leadership & Team: You will hire and build a great team of motivated people who bring our second location to success, starting with 2-3 FTEs. Your first hires will be Innovation Catalysts who support the development of the location and coach the projects. You foster a strong, value-driven culture aligned with ETH SPH in Zurich.

• Strategy & Offers: Together with your team and the Board, you will define and execute strategy for the St.Gallen location. You will develop and manage a portfolio of student-centred services for HSG and ETH students, ensuring high quality delivery and efficient processes. You will build on existing ETH SPH structures and learnings rather than start from scratch.

• Stakeholder Management: You will manage relationships with key stakeholders, including politicians, donors, university leadership, professors, and the Board. Working across ETH, HSG, and the START Foundation, you will secure long-term support beyond the initial two-year pilot phase by making the stakeholders excited about supporting this opportunity.

• Coaching & Facilitation: In the beginning you will coach early-stage projects and facilitate workshops and events. Based on the philosophy and approach we have developed at ETH SPH, you’ll help students to reflect, ask insightful questions, and support them to pin down their next steps, without taking on a leadership role.

• Location & Scaling: You will establish a highly vibrant location full of stud

descriptionByLocale.it:
Capo di HSG ETH Student Project House 80%-100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Alla Student Project House (SPH) ispiriamo e diamo potere agli studenti di coltivare un creatore e innovatore mentalità. Crediamo che sviluppando i propri progetti, gli studenti imparano competenze importanti per il loro futuro. Questo è il motivo per cui abbiamo creato un ecosistema per ispirare gli studenti (Bachelor, Master e Dottorato) per iniziare ed esplorare il reale bisogno dietro la loro idea. E cercare opinioni diverse, lavorare come squadra, pensare grande, fallire, per pivot, e continuare a superare gli ostacoli che incontrano lungo la strada. Il nostro team interdisciplinare di trenta persone progetta e gestisce strutture come co-lavoro, spazi di ideazione, così come un makerspace e laboratorio che dà agli studenti l'accesso agli strumenti e alle attrezzature di cui hanno bisogno per prototipo. Supportiamo team di progetto con personal coaching, workshop e una rete di esperti pro-bono dall'industria. La nostra prima posizione è stata fondata all'ETH di Zurigo. Mentre scaleamo e espandiamo oltre la nostra base originale, stiamo lanciando una seconda posizione a St.Gallen in collaborazione con l'Università di St.Gallen (HSG) e la Fondazione START. Stiamo creando un'organizzazione sorella nello spirito di SPH a Zurigo, con un grande focus sulla costruzione di una comunità di studenti ETH e HSG che imparano l'uno dall'altro attraverso l'apprendimento peer-to-peer. Stiamo ora cercando un capo di HSG ETH SPH per guidare questo nuovo capitolo. Sfondo del progetto Potrai lavorare in uno degli spazi più ispiranti di St.Gallen, circondato da lavagne bianche, attrezzature di ideazione, mobili colorati e studenti creativi. Siamo situati al START Campus, a 5 minuti dalla stazione St.Gallen e HSG. Lavoriamo nello stesso spazio aperto dei nostri team di progetto e ci incontriamo con tutti a livello degli occhi. Le persone con cui lavoriamo sono da una vasta gamma di sfondi e discipline di studio, motivo per cui comunichiamo in inglese. Poiché i progetti che sosteniamo sono extracurriculari, la maggior parte delle nostre offerte si svolgono nel tardo pomeriggio, la sera, e occasionalmente nei fine settimana. I progetti sono molto diversi per quanto riguarda argomento, stadio, intensità e obiettivo - alcuni essere imprenditoriali e altri no-profit. Prendiamo un approccio agile per concettualizzare e fornire la nostra offerta e allocare la nostra capacità in modo flessibile ai compiti più importanti. In questo modo, il lavoro di squadra è uno dei nostri valori chiave. Descrizione del lavoro Insieme, forniamo ai progetti guidati dagli studenti in innovazione e per la crescita personale. In qualità di capo di HSG ETH SPH, sei responsabile per i seguenti:
• Leadership & Team: Assumerete e costruirete una grande squadra di persone motivate che portano la nostra seconda posizione al successo, a partire da 2-3 FTE. I vostri primi assunti saranno Innovation Catalysts che sostengono lo sviluppo della posizione e coach i progetti. Tu adotti una cultura forte e orientata al valore allineata con ETH SPH a Zurigo.
• Strategia & Offerte: Insieme al vostro team e al Consiglio, definirete ed eserciterete la strategia per la posizione di St.Gallen. Svilupperai e gestirai un portafoglio di servizi dedicati agli studenti HSG e ETH, garantendo consegne di alta qualità e processi efficienti. Si costruirà su strutture e apprendimenti ETH SPH esistenti piuttosto che iniziare da zero.
• Gestione Stakeholder: gestirete i rapporti con i principali stakeholder, tra cui politici, donatori, leadership universitaria, professori e Consiglio. Lavorando attraverso ETH, HSG e la START Foundation, si assicurerà il supporto a lungo termine oltre la fase pilota iniziale di due anni, rendendo gli stakeholder entusiasti di sostenere questa opportunità.
• Coaching & Facilitation: All'inizio si allenano i progetti di primo stadio e facilitare workshop ed eventi. Sulla base della filosofia e dell’approccio che abbiamo sviluppato in ETH SPH, aiuterai gli studenti a riflettere, a porre domande intuitive e a sostenerli per individuare i loro passi successivi, senza assumere un ruolo di leadership.
• Posizione & Scaling: si stabilirà una posizione molto vivace piena di borchie

Leiter des HSG ETH Student Project House 80%-100%, Zürich, befristet Drucken Am Student Project House (SPH) inspirieren und befähigen wir Studierende, eine Macher- und Innovator-Mentalität zu pflegen. Wir glauben, dass Studenten durch die Entwicklung eigener Projekte wichtige Kompetenzen für ihre Zukunft erlernen. Aus diesem Grund haben wir ein Ökosystem geschaffen, um Studenten (Bachelor-, Master- und Doktoranden) dazu zu inspirieren, anzufangen und den wirklichen Bedarf hinter ihrer Idee zu erkunden. Und verschiedene Ansichten zu suchen, als Team zu arbeiten, groß zu denken, zu scheitern, sich zu drehen und Hindernisse zu überwinden, denen sie auf dem Weg begegnen. Unser interdisziplinäres Team von dreißig Mitarbeitern entwirft und verwaltet Einrichtungen wie Coworking, Ideation Spaces sowie einen Makerspace und ein Labor, das den Studenten Zugang zu den Werkzeugen und Geräten bietet, die sie für den Prototyp benötigen. Wir unterstützen Projektteams mit persönlichem Coaching, Workshops und einem pro-bono Expertennetzwerk aus der Industrie. Unser erster Standort wurde an der ETH Zürich gegründet. Während wir über unsere ursprüngliche Basis hinaus skalieren und expandieren, eröffnen wir in Zusammenarbeit mit der Universität St.Gallen (HSG) und der START Foundation einen zweiten Standort in St.Gallen. Wir schaffen eine Schwesterorganisation im Sinne von SPH in Zürich, mit einem großen Fokus auf den Aufbau einer Gemeinschaft von ETH- und HSG-Studierenden, die durch Peer-to-Peer-Learning voneinander lernen. Wir suchen nun einen Leiter der HSG ETH SPH, um dieses neue Kapitel zu führen. Projekthintergrund Sie arbeiten in einem der inspirierendsten Räume St.Gallens, umgeben von Whiteboards, Ideenausstattung, farbenfrohen Möbeln und kreativen Studenten. Wir befinden uns am START Campus, 5 Minuten vom Bahnhof St.Gallen und der HSG entfernt. Wir arbeiten im gleichen Freiraum wie unsere Projektteams und treffen uns mit allen auf Augenhöhe. Die Personen, mit denen wir arbeiten, stammen aus einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen und Studiendisziplinen, weshalb wir auf Englisch kommunizieren. Da die von uns unterstützten Projekte außerschulisch sind, finden die meisten unserer Angebote am späten Nachmittag, am Abend und gelegentlich am Wochenende statt. Die Projekte sind sehr vielfältig in Bezug auf Thema, Bühne, Intensität und Ziel - einige sind unternehmerisch und andere gemeinnützige. Wir gehen bei der Konzeption und Bereitstellung unseres Angebots agil vor und weisen unsere Kapazitäten flexibel auf die wichtigsten Aufgaben zu. Teamwork ist dabei einer unserer Schlüsselwerte. Zusammen stärken wir studentische Projekte in Innovation und für persönliches Wachstum. Als Leiter der HSG ETH SPH sind Sie für Folgendes verantwortlich:
• Leadership & Team: Sie werden ein großartiges Team von motivierten Leuten einstellen und aufbauen, die unseren zweiten Standort zum Erfolg bringen, beginnend mit 2-3 FTEs. Ihre ersten Mitarbeiter werden Innovationskatalysatoren sein, die die Entwicklung des Standorts unterstützen und die Projekte coachen. Sie fördern eine starke, werteorientierte Kultur, ausgerichtet auf die ETH SPH in Zürich.
• Strategie & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team und dem Vorstand definieren und realisieren Sie die Strategie für den Standort St.Gallen. Sie entwickeln und verwalten ein Portfolio von studentenzentrierten Dienstleistungen für HSG- und ETH-Studierende, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung und effiziente Prozesse zu gewährleisten. Sie bauen auf bestehenden ETH SPH Strukturen und Learnings auf, anstatt bei Null anzufangen.
• Stakeholder-Management: Sie verwalten die Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Politikern, Spendern, Universitätsleitungen, Professoren und dem Board. In Zusammenarbeit mit ETH, HSG und der START Foundation sichern Sie sich langfristige Unterstützung über die erste zweijährige Pilotphase hinaus, indem Sie die Stakeholder für die Unterstützung dieser Möglichkeit begeistern.
• Coaching & Facilitation: Am Anfang coachen Sie Frühphasenprojekte und ermöglichen Workshops und Veranstaltungen. Basierend auf der Philosophie und dem Ansatz, den wir an der ETH SPH entwickelt haben, helfen Sie den Studierenden, zu reflektieren, aufschlussreiche Fragen zu stellen und sie dabei zu unterstützen, ihre nächsten Schritte festzulegen, ohne eine Führungsrolle zu übernehmen.
• Lage & Skalierung: Sie werden eine sehr lebendige Lage voller Stud etablieren

Responsable de HSG ETH Student Project House 80%-100%, Zurich, tirage à durée déterminée Drucken Au Student Project House (SPH), nous inspirons et autorisons les étudiants à cultiver une mentalité créatrice et innovante. Nous croyons qu'en développant leurs propres projets, les étudiants acquièrent des compétences importantes pour leur avenir. C'est pourquoi nous avons créé un écosystème pour inspirer les étudiants (étudiants Bachelor, Master et Doctorat) à commencer et explorer le véritable besoin derrière leur idée. Et rechercher des points de vue divers, travailler en équipe, penser grand, échouer, pivoter, et continuer à surmonter les obstacles qu'ils rencontrent en chemin. Notre équipe interdisciplinaire de trente personnes conçoit et gère des installations comme le coworking, les espaces d'idées ainsi qu'un espace de fabrication et un laboratoire qui donnent aux étudiants l'accès aux outils et équipements dont ils ont besoin pour prototyper. Nous soutenons des équipes de projet avec un coaching personnel, des ateliers et un réseau d'experts pro-bono de l'industrie. Notre premier emplacement a été établi à l'ETH Zurich. Au fur et à mesure que nous nous étendons au-delà de notre base originale, nous lançons un deuxième site à St.Gallen en collaboration avec l'Université de St.Gallen (HSG) et la Fondation START. Nous créons une organisation sœur dans l'esprit de la SPH à Zurich, avec un large accent sur la construction d'une communauté d'étudiants ETH et HSG qui apprennent les uns des autres par l'apprentissage entre pairs. Nous cherchons maintenant un chef de HSG ETH SPH pour diriger ce nouveau chapitre. Contexte du projet Vous travaillerez dans l'un des espaces les plus inspirants de Saint-Gall, entouré de tableaux blancs, de matériel d'idées, de meubles colorés et d'étudiants créatifs. Nous sommes situés au campus START, à 5 minutes de la gare St.Gallen et du HSG. Nous travaillons dans le même espace ouvert que nos équipes de projet et rencontrons tout le monde au niveau des yeux. Les personnes avec lesquelles nous travaillons proviennent d'un éventail diversifié d'horizons et de disciplines d'études, c'est pourquoi nous communiquons en anglais. Comme les projets que nous soutenons sont extrascolaires, la plupart de nos offres ont lieu en fin d'après-midi, en soirée et parfois le week-end. Les projets sont très divers en ce qui concerne le sujet, l'étape, l'intensité et l'objectif - certains étant des entrepreneurs et d'autres sans but lucratif. Nous adoptons une approche agile pour conceptualiser et livrer notre offre et affecter notre capacité de manière flexible aux tâches les plus importantes. Le travail d'équipe est l'une de nos valeurs clés. Description du travail Ensemble, nous autonomisons les projets dirigés par des étudiants dans l'innovation et pour la croissance personnelle. En tant que chef de HSG ETH SPH, vous êtes responsable de ce qui suit :
• Leadership & Équipe : Vous allez embaucher et construire une grande équipe de personnes motivées qui apportent notre deuxième emplacement au succès, en commençant par 2-3 ETP. Vos premières embauches seront des catalyseurs de l'innovation qui soutiennent le développement de l'emplacement et coachent les projets. Vous favorisez une culture forte, axée sur la valeur, alignée sur l'ETH SPH à Zurich.
• Stratégie & Offres: Avec votre équipe et le Conseil, vous définirez et exécuterez la stratégie pour l'emplacement de St.Gallen. Vous développerez et gérerez un portefeuille de services axés sur les étudiants pour les étudiants HSG et ETH, assurant une prestation de haute qualité et des processus efficaces. jobs.description:
MaP Executive Director

80%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The ETH Zürich Competence Center for Materials and Processes ( MaP ) is a multidisciplinary scientific network devoted to tackling the grand challenges in materials, processes and manufacturing technologies. We foster cross-disciplinary research, education, and outreach to other academic institutes, industry and society in this field. Current major initiatives of MaP are the MaP Doctoral School and ETH Sabbatical | CAS AMaP continuing education programme. To lead the executive office as the central coordination hub, MaP is currently hiring a new Executive Director, starting from 1 July 2026 or earlier on agreement.

Project background

We are seeking an individual who is highly motivated to manage and develop MaP , together with the Steering Committee and the community of over 80 affiliated research groups . The Executive Director is responsible for leading the executive office, including managing strategy, human resources, finances, as well as operations and activities, governance and communications. The main focus of this key interfacing role is on community building and managing multi-stakeholder collaboration across a broad range of themes, therefore requiring a broad understanding of the grand challenges in Materials and Processes. The position embraces the designing, managing and overseeing of all research, education and outreach programs of MaP , including the MaP Doctoral School and ETH Sabbatical | CAS AMaP .

Job description

Strategic Leadership & Office Management

• Manage and develop MaP in close collaboration with the Steering Committee and a community of over 80 affiliated research groups.

• Lead the executive office, taking full responsibility for its operations and daily activities.

• Oversee core management areas, including strategy, human resources, finances, and governance.

Collaboration & Community Building

• Foster community building and manage multi-stakeholder collaboration across a broad range of themes.

• Act as a key interface between various research groups and research entities.

• Direct/Develop communication strategies to engage and connect the MaP community.

Program Management & Oversight

• Design, manage, and oversee all MaP research, education, and outreach programs.

• Direct specific initiatives, including the MaP Doctoral School and the ETH Sabbatical | CAS AMaP.

Profile

• The successful candidate has a strong academic background in science and/or engineering and ample work experience in topics relevant to Materials and Processes.

• Given the requirement to work across disciplines, sectors and cultures, the candidate must have excellent communication and organisational skills and experience in community building and further participatory processes.

• Strong project and business management skills are essential, from strategy and conceptualisation to planning and effective implementation, along with budgeting, financial management, evaluation and reporting.

• The ability to work in a motivated, independent, responsible, resourceful and resilient manner is vital.

• And, ideally, the candidate has already gained some hands-on experience in managing people, having budget responsibility and running research projects and education programs. Fluency in English and German is required.

Workplace

We offer

We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of freedom in design and implementation and many opportunities for an individual with commensurate qualifications, a can-do attitude, and a proactive and creative mindset to further her/his professional goals. The position is limited to one year, with the possibility of extension depending on the further development of MaP and its initiatives.

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity,

jobs.description:
Leiter:in Alarmorganisation (m/w/d)

100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Die Abteilung Facility Services stellt das technische und infrastrukturelle Gebäudemanagement aller von der ETH Zürich genutzten Gebäude und Räume sicher. Die angegliederte Alarmorganisation gliedert sich in die Teilbereiche Alarmzentrale (AZ) und Sicherheitsdienst (SiDi) und arbeitet im 3-Schichtbetrieb (24/7/365). Die Alarmzentrale ist die Anlaufstelle für sämtliche Vorkommnisse im Personen-, Gebäude- und Anlagenschutz. Der Sicherheitsdienst ist verantwortlich für die Kontrolle der sicherheitstechnischen Einrichtungen in den Gebäuden und die Erstintervention im Ereignisfall.

Bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, wenn jede Sekunde zählt?

Sie kennen den Alltag in einer Alarmorganisation nicht nur – sie leben ihn. Sie bleiben ruhig, wenn andere hektisch werden, treffen Entscheidungen mit klarem Kopf und führen Ihr Team auch unter Druck sicher ans Ziel? Dann wartet hier Ihre nächste Herausforderung als Leiter:in Alarmorganisation (m/w/d).

Gestalten Sie die Alarmorganisation der ETH Zürich aktiv mit und sorgen dafür, dass Sicherheit jederzeit gewährleistet ist.

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben – Verantwortung, Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum

In dieser Schlüsselposition übernehmen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für die Alarmorganisation der ETH Zürich mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden (inkl. 4 Direktunterstellten). Sie stellen sicher, dass sämtliche Ereignisse im Personen-, Gebäude- und Anlagenschutz an allen ETH-Standorten im 24/7/365-Betrieb professionell, effizient und zuverlässig bewältigt werden.

Sie führen die Teamleitung der Alarmzentrale, des Sicherheitsdienstes sowie die Fachstelle IT AMS und sorgen gemeinsam mit ihnen für eine hochverfügbare, qualitativ exzellente Leistungserbringung. Dabei haben Sie stets im Blick, dass Alarmzentrale und Sicherheitsdienst eine sichtbare Visitenkarte der ETH sind – entsprechend setzen Sie auf Professionalität, Respekt und einem starken Teamauftritt.

Ein zentraler Teil Ihrer Arbeit ist die Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Sie analysieren bestehende Abläufe, optimieren Prozesse gezielt und treiben die Digitalisierung voran. Sie stellen sicher, dass Systeme wie AMS auf dem neuesten Stand sind und definieren technische Tools, die den operativen Alltag effizient unterstützen. Gleichzeitig garantieren Sie die konsequente Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen sowie ETH-internen Vorgaben.

Sie führen strukturierte Qualitätsprüfungen und Debriefings durch, leiten konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab und sorgen dafür, dass die Organisation kontinuierlich dazulernt und sich weiterentwickelt.

In Ihrer Führungsrolle setzen Sie klare Ziele, delegieren wirkungsvoll und schaffen Transparenz. Sie entwickeln Ihre Mitarbeitenden aktiv weiter – durch Standortbestimmungen, Schulungen, Talentförderung und vorausschauende Nachfolgeplanung. Auch in herausfordernden Situationen bleiben Sie präsent, treffen schnelle Entscheidungen und führen Ihr Team souverän durch herausfordernde Lagen.

Zusätzlich verantworten Sie zentrale organisatorische Aufgaben wie Budgetplanung, Schichtplanung sowie die Einhaltung von Finanz- und Beschaffungsrichtlinien. Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen, stellen den Informationsfluss zur Abteilungsleitung sicher und sorgen für eine klare, stufengerechte Kommunikation.

Darüber hinaus leiten Sie Projekte und arbeiten aktiv in bereichsübergreifenden Initiativen mit und gestalten so die Weiterentwicklung der Alarmorganisation nachhaltig mit. Durch kontinuierliche Aus- und Weiterbildung bleiben Sie fachlich und methodisch am Puls der Zeit.

Profil

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre sowie Abschluss als Fachmann/-frau für Sicherheit und Bewachung, den Fachaus

Responsabile Organizzazione allarmi (m/f/d) 100%, Zurigo, stampa permanente Stampa Il dipartimento Facility Services garantisce la gestione tecnica e infrastrutturale di tutti gli edifici e locali utilizzati dall'ETH di Zurigo. L'organizzazione allarme convenzionata è suddivisa nelle sottoaree centrale allarme (AZ) e servizio sicurezza (SiDi) e opera su 3 turni (24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, 365 giorni l'anno). La centrale allarmi è il punto di contatto per tutti gli incidenti relativi alla protezione delle persone, degli edifici e degli impianti. Il servizio di sicurezza è responsabile del controllo delle dotazioni di sicurezza degli edifici e del primo intervento in caso di incidente. Pronto ad assumerti la responsabilità quando ogni secondo conta? Non solo conoscono la vita quotidiana in un’organizzazione di allarme, ma la vivono. Rimani calmo quando gli altri sono frenetici, prendi decisioni con la mente lucida e guidi la tua squadra in sicurezza verso i propri obiettivi anche sotto pressione? Allora qui ti aspetta la tua prossima sfida come capo dell'organizzazione di allarme (m/f/d). Contribuite attivamente a definire l'organizzazione degli allarmi dell'ETH di Zurigo e assicuratevi che la sicurezza sia sempre garantita. Descrizione del lavoro I tuoi compiti: responsabilità, impatto e spazio per la creatività In questa posizione chiave assumerai la responsabilità generale dell'organizzazione degli allarmi presso l'ETH di Zurigo con circa 20 dipendenti (di cui 4 dipendenti diretti). Garantiscono che tutti gli eventi di protezione delle persone, degli edifici e delle strutture in tutte le sedi dell'ETH siano gestiti in modo professionale, efficiente e affidabile 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, 365 giorni all'anno. Dirigi la gestione del team della centrale di allarme, del servizio di sicurezza e del reparto IT AMS e, insieme a loro, garantisci una fornitura di servizi altamente disponibile e di eccellente qualità. Tieni sempre presente che la centrale d'allarme e il servizio di sicurezza sono un biglietto da visita visibile dell'ETH, quindi fai affidamento sulla professionalità, sul rispetto e su una forte presenza di squadra. Una parte centrale del tuo lavoro è l'ulteriore sviluppo dell'organizzazione: analizzi i processi esistenti, ottimizzi i processi in modo mirato e porti avanti la digitalizzazione. Garantisci che sistemi come AMS/AHF siano aggiornati e definisci strumenti tecnici che supportano in modo efficiente le operazioni quotidiane. jobs.description:
Fachspezialist:in finanzielles Projektreporting (m/w/d)

100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Innerhalb des Vizepräsidiums Finanzen & Controlling fungiert die Sektion Finanzielles Drittmittelreporting als zentrale Fachstelle für die finanzielle Berichterstattung gegenüber nationalen und internationalen Geldgebern. Wir unterstützen akademische Einheiten sowie zentrale Verwaltungsorgane kompetent in sämtlichen Fragen des finanziellen Projektreportings.

Du liebst Zahlen, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projektreportings den Überblick?

Du möchtest aktiv dazu beitragen, dass Forschungsprojekte finanziell sauber, transparent und regelkonform abgewickelt werden?

Dann wartet hier eine spannende Herausforderung auf dich – mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum als Fachspezialist:in finanzielles Projektreporting (m/w/d).

Stellenbeschreibung

In dieser Rolle bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für ETH-interne Kunden rund um die finanziellen Aspekte drittmittelfinanzierter Projekte. Du berätst Professuren und Projektverantwortliche kompetent und sorgst dafür, dass finanzielle Reportings präzise, termingerecht und regelkonform erstellt werden.

Ein Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit liegt in der finanziellen Berichterstattung von SNF-Forschungsprojekten. Dabei erstellst du innerhalb klarer Zeitvorgaben eine hohe Anzahl an Finanzberichten teilautomatisiert, zuverlässig und in hoher Qualität. Du arbeitest strukturiert und präzise, stellst eine saubere Dokumentation sicher und wickelst die Prozesse effizient ab.

Trotz des hohen Volumens behältst du den Überblick, erkennst Unstimmigkeiten, führst notwendige Prüfschritte sorgfältig durch und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der geltenden ETH-Reglemente sowie der SNF-Beitrags- und Ausführungsbestimmungen.

Darüber hinaus erstellst du Finanzberichte für weitere nationale und internationale Fördergeber wie Innosuisse oder die Europäische Kommission. Du pflegst aktiv den Kontakt zu allen beteiligten Stellen, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst eine reibungslose sowie fristgerechte Abrechnung sicher.

Du bringst dich zudem in die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Informationsveranstaltungen ein und unterstützt die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Digitalisierung unserer Finanzprozesse – gerne auch mit innovativen Ansätzen, beispielsweise durch Automatisierung oder den Einsatz neuer Tools.

Profil

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Weiterbildung (oder Bereitschaft dazu)

• Erste Erfahrung im Finanzbereich, idealerweise im Projektreporting oder Drittmittelumfeld

• Starkes analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis

• Ganzheitliches Prozessverständnis und die Fähigkeit, auch bei Routineaufgaben Unstimmigkeiten zu erkennen

• Sehr sorgfältige, strukturierte und effiziente Arbeitsweise

• Hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse

• Sehr gute MS Office Kenntnisse (insbesondere Excel), SAP von Vorteil

• Interesse an Digitalisierung sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierung oder KI-gestützten Tools

Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet

Im Sinne der ETH-Sozial- und Leadershipkompetenzen bringst du mehr als nur Fachwissen mit:

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck zuverlässig und präzise

• Mit deinem vernetzten Denken erkennst du Zusammenhänge und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen

• Klar und adressatengerecht kommunizieren gehört für dich ebenso dazu wie die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen

• Du bringst dich aktiv ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und treibst Verbesserungen voran

• Dank deiner strukturierten

Specialista nel reporting di progetti finanziari (m/f/d) 100%, Zurigo, stampa permanente Stampa All'interno della Vice President Finance & Controlling, la sezione Reporting finanziario di terzi funge da ufficio specializzato centrale per il reporting finanziario ai donatori nazionali e internazionali. Forniamo supporto competente alle unità accademiche e agli organi amministrativi centrali in tutte le questioni relative alla rendicontazione dei progetti finanziari. Ami i numeri, pensi per processi e mantieni una visione d'insieme anche con reportistica di progetti complessi? Ti piacerebbe contribuire attivamente a garantire che i progetti di ricerca siano condotti in modo finanziariamente pulito, trasparente e conforme? Allora qui ti aspetta una sfida entusiasmante - con molta responsabilità personale e libertà creativa come specialista nel reporting di progetti finanziari (m/f/d). Descrizione del lavoro In questo ruolo sei il referente centrale per i clienti interni dell'ETH per quanto riguarda gli aspetti finanziari dei progetti finanziati da terzi. Fornisci consulenza competente a professori e project manager e garantisci che i rapporti finanziari siano creati in modo preciso, puntuale e conforme alle regole. Uno dei focus del vostro lavoro è il rendiconto finanziario dei progetti di ricerca del FNS. Creerai un gran numero di report finanziari in modo semiautomatico, affidabile e di alta qualità entro scadenze chiare. Lavori in modo strutturato e preciso, garantisci una documentazione pulita e gestisci i processi in modo efficiente. Nonostante l'elevato volume, mantenete una visione d'insieme, identificate le discrepanze, effettuate scrupolosamente i controlli necessari e garantite il rispetto delle norme applicabili del PF nonché delle norme di finanziamento e di attuazione del FNS. Preparerai anche rapporti finanziari per altre agenzie di finanziamento nazionali e internazionali come Innosuisse o la Commissione europea. Mantieni attivamente i contatti con tutti i dipartimenti coinvolti, coordini i processi e garantisci una fatturazione regolare e tempestiva. Sarai inoltre coinvolto nella preparazione e realizzazione di eventi informativi e sosterrai il continuo sviluppo e la digitalizzazione dei nostri processi finanziari, anche con approcci innovativi, ad esempio attraverso l'automazione o l'utilizzo di nuovi strumenti. Profilo
• Formazione commerciale di base con ulteriore formazione in amministrazione aziendale (o disponibilità a farlo)
• Esperienza iniziale nel settore finanziario, preferibilmente in ambienti di reporting di progetti o di finanziamento di terze parti
• Forti capacità di pensiero analitico e una forte comprensione dei numeri
• Comprensione olistica dei processi e capacità di riconoscere incoerenze anche nelle attività di routine
• Modo di lavorare molto attento, strutturato ed efficiente
• Elevato orientamento al servizio e piacere di lavorare con partner interni ed esterni
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese
• Ottima conoscenza di MS Office (in particolare Excel), SAP è un vantaggio
• Interesse per la digitalizzazione e possibilmente prima esperienza con l'automazione o con strumenti supportati dall'intelligenza artificiale Ciò che ti distingue inoltre In termini di competenze sociali e di leadership del PF, porti molto più che semplici conoscenze specialistiche:
• ti assumi responsabilità e lavori in modo affidabile e preciso anche sotto pressione di tempo
• con il tuo pensiero in rete, riconosci le connessioni e sviluppi soluzioni sostenibili
• comunicare in modo chiaro e appropriato è importante per te tanto quanto lavorare con diversi gruppi di stakeholder
• ti coinvolgi attivamente, metti in discussione i processi esistenti e porti avanti miglioramenti
• grazie alla tua struttura strutturata

Specialist in financial project reporting (m/f/d) 100%, Zurich, permanent print Print Within the Vice President Finance & Controlling, the Financial Third-Party Funding Reporting section acts as a central specialist office for financial reporting to national and international donors. We provide competent support to academic units and central administrative bodies in all questions of financial project reporting. Do you love numbers, think in processes and keep an overview even with complex project reporting? Would you like to actively contribute to ensuring that research projects are carried out in a financially clean, transparent and compliant manner? Then an exciting challenge awaits you here - with a lot of personal responsibility and creative freedom as a specialist in financial project reporting (m/f/d). Job description In this role, you are the central contact person for ETH-internal customers regarding the financial aspects of third-party funded projects. You provide competent advice to professors and project managers and ensure that financial reports are created precisely, on time and in accordance with the rules. One focus of your work is the financial reporting of SNSF research projects. You will create a large number of financial reports semi-automatically, reliably and in high quality within clear deadlines. You work in a structured and precise manner, ensure clean documentation and handle the processes efficiently. Despite the high volume, you maintain an overview, identify discrepancies, carefully carry out the necessary checks and ensure compliance with the applicable ETH regulations as well as the SNSF funding and implementation regulations. You will also prepare financial reports for other national and international funding agencies such as Innosuisse or the European Commission. You actively maintain contact with all departments involved, coordinate processes and ensure smooth and timely billing. You will also be involved in the preparation and implementation of information events and support the continuous development and digitalization of our financial processes - including with innovative approaches, for example through automation or the use of new tools. Profile
• Basic commercial training with further business administration training (or willingness to do so)
• Initial experience in the financial sector, ideally in project reporting or third-party funding environments
• Strong analytical thinking skills and a strong understanding of numbers
• Holistic understanding of processes and the ability to recognize inconsistencies even in routine tasks
• Very careful, structured and efficient way of working
• High service orientation and enjoy working with internal and external partners
• Very good German and good English skills
• Very good MS Office knowledge (especially Excel), SAP is an advantage
• Interest in digitalization and ideally first experience with automation or AI-supported tools What additionally sets you apart In terms of ETH social and leadership skills, you bring more than just specialist knowledge:
• You take on responsibility and work reliably and precisely even under time pressure
• With your networked thinking, you recognize connections and develop sustainable solutions
• Communicating clearly and in an appropriate manner is just as important for you as working with different stakeholder groups
• You get actively involved, question existing processes and drive Improvements ahead
• Thanks to your structured

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Light-Driven CO2 Capture

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Electrochemical Energy Systems Laboratory in the Department of Mechanical and Process Engineering at ETH Zurich invites applications for a Postdoctoral Researcher position focused on light-driven CO2 capture.

Job description

• Our group is actively developing a novel photoacid-based approach for efficient CO2 capture, optimizing both the local chemical environment in photoacids and their molecular structure to enhance sorption capacity and stability

• We seek a postdoctoral researcher who will contribute to these efforts

• You will join a diverse, inclusive, and supportive work environment that values scientific curiosity and creativity

Profile

• PhD in Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a related field

• Experience with in situ spectroscopy is a plus

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Self-driven, highly motivated, and strong teamwork skills

We welcome applications from candidates with expertise in organic synthesis and one or more of the following areas:

• Photochemistry

• Advanced characterization techniques (e.g., synchrotron facilities, in-situ methods)

• CO2 capture / utilization is a plus

We are looking for highly motivated researchers with a passion for contributing to solutions in the global energy landscape. If you excel in collaborative environments and can bring expertise in some of the areas listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Workplace

We offer

• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

In the field for additional information, please include your PhD, MSc, and BSc degree details (university, dates, and relevant experience).

jobs.description:
PhD Position in Global Trade, Supply Chains and Climate Shocks

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

Research Division KOF Lab of ETH Zurich’s KOF Swiss Economic Institute is seeking a PhD candidate to study the propagation of weather and climate shocks in quantitative trade network models. The position is part of the National Centre of Competence in Research project Climate Extremes and Society: Strengthening Resilience (NCCR CLIM+). NCCR CLIM+ is a new, interdisciplinary, Switzerland-wide climate research community involving multiple investigators at ETH Zurich and other Swiss institutions.

Job description

• The project at KOF Lab will center around assessing and promoting the resilience of supply chains by building and solving quantitative global equilibrium models of trade networks.

• We will use firm-level data to estimate the industry/country-level effects of various weather and climate shocks and input the estimated impacts into the model.

• To this end, the doctoral candidate will leverage theoretical, computational, and econometric tools to study public policy questions related to the resilience of global supply chains to climate change.

• The doctorate will be conducted within the doctoral program of D-MTEC (Department of Management, Technology, and Economics) and is expected to be completed within four years.

• The candidate will be supervised primarily by Professor Hans Gersbach and Dr. Kieran Walsh.

• The position is for up to four years. The salary is in accordance with the PhD regulations of the Swiss National Science Foundation, which funds the NCCR.

Profile

• The applicant should have a master’s degree in economics or finance. We will also consider candidates with a master’s degree in mathematics or statistics, provided they have completed some coursework in economics and are prepared to do intensive economics PhD training.

• Applicants must be highly proficient in English.

• The applicant should be proficient in either MATLAB, Python, or Julia and willing to work in MATLAB.

• Prior coursework in (i) trade theory and (ii) environmental economics would be a major asset.

• Experience with panel data econometrics would be beneficial.

Workplace

We offer

• We offer the opportunity to apply cutting-edge economic theory to practical policy issues at the intersection of trade and climate change.

• Candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to NCCR CLIM+ research discussions.

• We offer the opportunity to join KOF, which is Switzerland’s leading academic institute for applied economic research. It provides independent and objective data and facts, as well as timely assessments to support decision-makers in politics and business in making fact-based decisions for the benefit of Swiss society.

• KOF PhD students are part of a large and vibrant community of economic researchers. The broader economics community in Zurich offers the opportunity to participate in numerous workshops and conferences spanning all fields of economics.

We value diversity and sustainability

Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

• A letter of motivation, which should include a proposed starting date

• Your CV, which should include contact information for three references (no letters are needed at this point)

PhD Position in Global Trade, Supply Chains and Climate Shocks 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken Research Division KOF Lab of ETH Zurich’s KOF Swiss Economic Institute is seeking a PhD candidate to study the propagation of weather and climate shocks in quantitative trade network models. The position is part of the National Centre of Competence in Research project Climate Extremes and Society: Strengthening Resilience (NCCR CLIM+). NCCR CLIM+ is a new, interdisciplinary, Switzerland-wide climate research community involving multiple investigators at ETH Zurich and other Swiss institutions. Job description
• The project at KOF Lab will center around assessing and promoting the resilience of supply chains by building and solving quantitative global equilibrium models of trade networks.
• We will use firm-level data to estimate the industry/country-level effects of various weather and climate shocks and input the estimated impacts into the model.
• To this end, the doctoral candidate will leverage theoretical, computational, and econometric tools to study public policy questions related to the resilience of global supply chains to climate change.
• The doctorate will be conducted within the doctoral program of D-MTEC (Department of Management, Technology, and Economics) and is expected to be completed within four years.
• The candidate will be supervised primarily by Professor Hans Gersbach and Dr. Kieran Walsh.
• The position is for up to four years. The salary is in accordance with the PhD regulations of the Swiss National Science Foundation, which funds the NCCR. Profile
• The applicant should have a master’s degree in economics or finance. We will also consider candidates with a master’s degree in mathematics or statistics, provided they have completed some coursework in economics and are prepared to do intensive economics PhD training.
• Applicants must be highly proficient in English.
• The applicant should be proficient in either MATLAB, Python, or Julia and willing to work in MATLAB.
• Prior coursework in (i) trade theory and (ii) environmental economics would be a major asset.
• Experience with panel data econometrics would be beneficial. Workplace Workplace We offer
• We offer the opportunity to apply cutting-edge economic theory to practical policy issues at the intersection of trade and climate change.
• Candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to NCCR CLIM+ research discussions.
• We offer the opportunity to join KOF, which is Switzerland’s leading academic institute for applied economic research. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future . Curious? So are we. • A letter of motivation, which should include a proposed starting date
• Your CV, which should include contact information for three references (no letters are needed at this point)
